params.prompt:
Create a production 2D dress-up mobile game sprite sheet: EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal square cells, no visible grid, no labels, no text. Entire background pure uniform cyan #00FFFF (key color), no cyan anywhere on objects. Hand-painted pastel cartoon, crisp dark plum outlines, soft gentle shading, elegant casual proportions like a paper doll, NOT photorealistic. Every sprite isolated with generous margin and nothing touching cell boundaries. Character: a smiling adult woman with warm brown skin, long dark curly hair swept behind shoulders. Full body head to toes, facing directly forward, arms slightly away from body, right hand lowered, legs straight, same neutral standing pose in ALL FOUR character states, exact same scale and head/feet registration in each cell. All characters adult. Figure occupies 90% of cell height, centered. NO floor, scenery, shadow, sparkles, extra people or extra objects.
ROW 1 COL 1: character wearing a simple modest ivory sleeveless knee-length slip dress, bare feet, no accessories.
ROW 1 COL 2: SAME character wearing a pale peach knee-length floral dress with a fitted waist and softly flared skirt, bare feet, no accessories.
ROW 1 COL 3: SAME character wearing the identical a pale peach knee-length floral dress with a fitted waist and softly flared skirt, plus a short ivory cardigan worn open, plus a pair of peach ballet flats, no bag or hair clip.
ROW 2 COL 1: SAME character wearing the identical dress, jacket and shoes, plus a small woven straw handbag held by her RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT), plus a peach flower hair clip above her LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT).
ROW 2 COL 2: ONLY the exact a pale peach knee-length floral dress with a fitted waist and softly flared skirt, front view empty garment, no body, no hanger.
ROW 2 COL 3: ONLY the exact a short ivory cardigan worn open, front view empty garment, no body or hanger.
ROW 3 COL 1: ONLY the matching a pair of peach ballet flats, pair side by side, toes facing viewer.
ROW 3 COL 2: ONLY the matching a small woven straw handbag.
ROW 3 COL 3: ONLY the matching a peach flower hair clip.
All clothing props must match the garments on the character exactly. Four full-body characters and five clothing/accessory props, nothing else.
